activities.title: Leaf clue warm-up
activities.description: Pairs inspect fresh leaves with hand lenses and predict where light is captured.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Partner predictions identifying where light is captured.

activities.title: Cell parts quick review
activities.description: A short labelled-diagram review of the cell parts needed for photosynthesis.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Correctly labelled chloroplast and cell wall.

activities.title: Chlorophyll reveal
activities.description: Groups examine leaf cross-sections and connect chloroplast location to light absorption.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Annotated diagram linking chloroplasts to light absorption.

activities.title: Equation card sort
activities.description: Teams sort reactants, products and conditions into the photosynthesis word equation.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Completed word equation with reactants and products in the right order.

activities.title: Explain-it board
activities.description: Students build a visual explanation of photosynthesis on a shared whiteboard.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Whiteboard explanation with a labelled energy flow.

activities.title: Design-a-leaf challenge
activities.description: Students design a leaf for a low-light environment and justify its adaptations.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Annotated leaf design with a written adaptation justification.

activities.title: Exit ticket: chlorophyll paragraph
activities.description: Students write a short paragraph explaining the role of chlorophyll.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Exit paragraph scored against the chlorophyll success criterion.

activities.title: One-minute summary
activities.description: A timed partner summary linking photosynthesis to food chains and oxygen.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Partner summary naming one global reason photosynthesis matters.

activities.title: Force picture sort
activities.description: Groups sort everyday pictures into balanced and unbalanced force examples.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Sorted examples with a spoken justification.

activities.title: Trolley ramp investigation
activities.description: Groups measure how far a trolley travels and discuss the forces involved.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Results table with distance, time and a force explanation.

activities.title: Speed calculation relay
activities.description: Teams race to solve speed problems and check each other's units.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Worked speed calculations with correct units.

activities.title: Concept cartoon discussion
activities.description: Students evaluate competing explanations of a balanced-force situation.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Oral explanation choosing and defending one cartoon character.

activities.title: Exit ticket: balanced or unbalanced
activities.description: A short individual check classifying two force diagrams.
activities.subject: Science
activities.assessment_evidence: Two diagrams correctly classified with a reason.

activities.title: Advert analysis
activities.description: Groups identify how an advert persuades its audience.
activities.subject: English
activities.assessment_evidence: Annotated advert with two persuasive techniques named.

activities.title: Persuasive word bank
activities.description: Students build a shared bank of persuasive verbs and connectives.
activities.subject: English
activities.assessment_evidence: Three useful words added to the class bank.

activities.title: Ethos, pathos, logos card sort
activities.description: Teams sort examples of the three rhetorical appeals and justify their choices.
activities.subject: English
activities.assessment_evidence: Correctly sorted examples with a written justification.

activities.title: Debate carousel
activities.description: Groups rotate through short debates, practising appeals and counterarguments.
activities.subject: English
activities.assessment_evidence: Teacher observation of one appeal and one counterargument.

activities.title: Persuasive opening rewrite
activities.description: Students rewrite a weak opening paragraph to add a hook and clear position.
activities.subject: English
activities.assessment_evidence: Rewritten opening with a hook and thesis underlined.

activities.title: Challenge: counterargument
activities.description: Students add a counterargument and rebuttal to a persuasive paragraph.
activities.subject: English
activities.assessment_evidence: A counterargument and rebuttal in one paragraph.

activities.title: Peer pitch
activities.description: Pairs deliver a one-minute pitch and give feedback on the strongest appeal.
activities.subject: English
activities.assessment_evidence: Peer feedback naming one effective appeal.

activities.title: Exit slip: one appeal
activities.description: Students identify the appeal used in one sentence and explain why it works.
activities.subject: English
activities.assessment_evidence: One appeal correctly named with a short explanation.

activities.title: Fraction wall warm-up
activities.description: Students use fraction walls to find equivalent fractions.
activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.assessment_evidence: Three equivalent fraction pairs found and recorded.

activities.title: Times-table sprint
activities.description: A quick individual multiplication check to prepare for common denominators.
activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.assessment_evidence: Times-table sprint score recorded.

activities.title: Pizza fraction workshop
activities.description: Groups use fraction circles to add and subtract fractions with different denominators.
activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.assessment_evidence: Worked calculations with common denominators shown.

activities.title: Error hunt
activities.description: Teams find and correct mistakes in worked fraction calculations.
activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.assessment_evidence: Errors identified with a corrected calculation.

activities.title: Word-problem carousel
activities.description: Groups rotate through fraction word problems and compare methods.
activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.assessment_evidence: Two word problems solved with reasoning shown.

activities.title: Challenge: recipe scaling
activities.description: Students scale a recipe up and down, reasoning with fractions.
activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.assessment_evidence: Scaled recipe with fractional quantities explained.

activities.title: Show-me boards
activities.description: The class solves fraction calculations on mini whiteboards for instant feedback.
activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.assessment_evidence: Whole-class responses to three fraction calculations.

activities.title: Exit ticket: fraction calculation
activities.description: A short individual check of one addition and one subtraction.
activities.subject: Mathematics
activities.assessment_evidence: Two calculations with common denominators shown.
